info.name: SaarthiX - API flow tests
info.description: Import + Run (Collection Runner). Sab requests order me chalni chahiye. Pehle `baseUrl`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword`, `cronSecret` variables dekho.

exec: // a date that is always in the future (2 days ahead)

request.description: Admin pehle script se banana padta hai: server/scripts/createAdmin.js. Email/password collection variables me set karo.

item.name: Student requests UNVERIFIED alumni -> must fail

exec: pm.test("Unverified alumni cannot be requested (status 400, 403, 404)", function () { pm.expect([400, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Student tries to ACCEPT own request -> 403

exec: pm.test("Cannot schedule without a session (status 409)", function () { pm.expect([409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Schedule with valid https link (saves sessionId)

exec: pm.test("17:00 IST is stored as 11:30 UTC", function () { pm.expect(s.scheduledAt).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('futureDate') + 'T11:30:00.000Z'); });

pm.test("session attached with Meet link (Join Meet button data)", function () { pm.expect(r.session.meetLink).to.eql('https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij'); pm.expect(r.session.status).to.eql('scheduled'); pm.expect(r.session.scheduledAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("same session id for alumni", function () { pm.expect(r.session.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('sessionId')); });

item.name: Completed request: no Meet data needed (status check)

exec: pm.test("request completed (UI shows NO Join Meet button)", function () { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('completed'); });

item.name: Schedule session 10 MIN from now (reminder is due immediately)

request.description: scheduledAt ISO (UTC, 'Z') bhi chalta hai. Sirf 10 minute baad ka session => reminder turant eligible.

item.name: Trigger reminder pass now (needs CRON_SECRET on server)

exec: pm.test("200 = ran, 404 = CRON_SECRET not set on server (then wait ~1 min for the built-in scheduler) (status 200, 404)", function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test("alumni got SESSION_REMINDER (agar fail ho: 1 minute ruk ke dobara run karo)", function () { pm.expect(n, 'notification missing').to.exist; pm.expect(n.type).to.eql('SESSION_REMINDER'); pm.expect(n.isRead).to.eql(false); pm.expect(n.message).to.include('Postman Other Student'); });
pm.test("student got SESSION_REMINDER with alumni name", function () { pm.expect(n, 'notification missing').to.exist; pm.expect(n.message).to.include('Postman Alumni'); });

item.name: Notifications still exactly ONE reminder for that session
Another user marks notification as read -> 404

exec: pm.test("Cannot touch someone else's notification (status 404)", function () { pm.expect([404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: After cancel: request has NO session (no Meet button)

exec: pm.test("request cancelled and session is null", function () { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(r.session).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("401 (secret set) or 404 (feature off) (status 401, 404)", function () { pm.expect([401, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
